########################################
#
# Script contains analyis to compare V-region identity of matching UMI-SPBC
# across S1_ONT_Q10, S1_ONT_Q17 and S1_PB_Q17. Groups are matching between all 
# three datasets; figures show pairwise V-region identity from the matching pool.
#
# Scatter show pairwise dataset comparison of the V-region identity distribution.
# Plots are split by group-support (< 3 and >= 3) as well as by receptor (BCR and TCR)
#
# Results are shown in LongAIRR Fig. 4f, 4g
#
########################################

library(dplyr)

library(scales)
library(stringr)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)

read in samples
```{r}
# set-up for input and group comparisons
samples_tbl <- tribble(
  ~sample,     ~receptor, ~airr_tsv,
  # TCR
  "S1_ONT_Q17", "TCR",     airr_path_12_tp,
  "S1_ONT_Q10", "TCR",     airr_path_12_10sd_tp,
  "S1_PB_Q17",  "TCR",     airr_path_pb_tp,
  # BCR
  "S1_ONT_Q17", "BCR",     airr_path_12_bp,
  "S1_ONT_Q10", "BCR",     airr_path_12_10sd_bp,
  "S1_PB_Q17",  "BCR",     airr_path_pb_bp)

samples_keep <- c("S1_ONT_Q10", "S1_ONT_Q17", "S1_PB_Q17")

comparisons <- tribble(
  ~g1,         ~g2,
  "S1_ONT_Q10", "S1_ONT_Q17",
  "S1_ONT_Q10", "S1_PB_Q17",
  "S1_ONT_Q17", "S1_PB_Q17") %>%
  mutate(comp = paste0(g1, " − ", g2))
```


---function set up

functions to read in data / find matching groups (spbc, umi) and sort them into groups based on consensus support

also one function to create in-plot legend text
```{r}
within_cutoff <- 1 # to compute shared similarity within certain range (here within 1%)
axis_xlim <- c(75, 100)
axis_ylim <- c(75, 100)

# read in function including filtering of sequence groups with poly-T UMI annotation, mismatching locus annotation or N-nucleotides
read_airr <- function(path, sample, receptor) {
  dt <- fread(path, sep = "\t", data.table = FALSE)

  dt %>%
       mutate(v_region_sequence = stringr::str_sub(toupper(sequence),
              start = as.integer(v_sequence_start), end = as.integer(v_sequence_end))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(c_call) & str_sub(c_call, 1, 3) == locus & !grepl("TTTTTTTTTTT", umi) & !grepl("N", junction)) %>%
    filter(!grepl("N", v_region_sequence)) %>%
    transmute(sample = sample,
      receptor = receptor,
      spbc = as.character(spbc),
      umi = as.character(umi),
      locus = as.character(locus),
      consensus_count = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(consensus_count)),
      v_identity = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v_identity))) %>%
    mutate(v_identity = if_else(!is.na(v_identity) & v_identity <= 1, v_identity * 100, v_identity),
           match_key = paste(spbc, umi, sep = "|"))
         # match_key = paste(spbc, umi, locus, sep = "|"))
}

all_airr <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(samples_tbl)), function(i) {
  read_airr(samples_tbl$airr_tsv[i], samples_tbl$sample[i], samples_tbl$receptor[i])}))

# matching molecules across all samples and split into two categories ( consensus support (n < 3 vs n >= 3))
build_bins_n1 <- function(df_r) {

  paired_base <- df_r %>%
    filter(sample %in% samples_keep, is.finite(v_identity)) %>%
    group_by(match_key) %>%
    filter(n_distinct(sample) == length(samples_keep)) %>%
    ungroup()

  binned <- bind_rows(
    paired_base %>%
      filter(!is.na(consensus_count), consensus_count < 3) %>%
      mutate(bin = "Consensus: < 3 reads"),

    paired_base %>%
      filter(!is.na(consensus_count), consensus_count >= 3) %>%
      mutate(bin = "Consensus: ≥ 3 reads")) %>%
    mutate(bin = factor(bin, levels = c("Consensus: < 3 reads", "Consensus: ≥ 3 reads")))
  # only keep pairs where all matches are in the same group (!!)
  binned %>%
    group_by(bin, match_key) %>%
    filter(n_distinct(sample) == length(samples_keep)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(bin = factor(bin, levels = c("Consensus: < 3 reads", "Consensus: ≥ 3 reads")))
}

# long format including bin, comparison, x, y and delta info
make_scatter_long <- function(df_binned) {
  wide <- df_binned %>%
    select(bin, match_key, sample, v_identity) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = v_identity) %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(samples_keep), ~ is.finite(.x)))

  # build long df for all comparisons (pairwise ONT's vs PB)
  out <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(comparisons)), function(i) {
                  g1 <- comparisons$g1[i]
                  g2 <- comparisons$g2[i]
                  comp <- comparisons$comp[i]
                  # new table with bin, comparison (comp), x (g2), y (g1) and delta
                  wide %>%
                    transmute(
                      bin, comp,
                      x = .data[[g2]],
                      y = .data[[g1]],
                      delta = .data[[g1]] - .data[[g2]])
                }))

  out %>%
    mutate(comp = factor(comp, levels = comparisons$comp),
           bin  = factor(bin, levels = c("Consensus: < 3 reads", "Consensus: ≥ 3 reads")))
      #bin  = factor(bin, levels = c("n = 1", "n > 1", "n > 2", "n > 3")))
}


# figure labels for: N (matching sequence groups), mean, % within similarity-cutoff
make_stats_labels <- function(df_long) {
  df_long %>%
    group_by(bin, comp) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n(),
      mean_delta = mean(delta),
      pct_within = mean(abs(delta) <= within_cutoff) * 100, .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(label = paste0("N = ", comma(N),
                   "\nMean Δ = ", sprintf("%.2f", mean_delta),
                   "\n% within ±", within_cutoff, " = ", sprintf("%.1f", pct_within), "%"),
          x_lab = axis_xlim[1] + 11, y_lab = axis_ylim[1] + 5.5)
}
```

figure function
```{r}
plot_scatter_grid <- function(df_long, x_lab_text = "BCR V identity (%) - right platform", y_lab_text = "BCR V identity (%) - left platform", title = NULL) {

  labs_df <- make_stats_labels(df_long)

  ggplot(df_long, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.18, size = 0.7) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red",linewidth = 0.35) +
    facet_grid(bin ~ comp) +
    geom_text(data = labs_df, aes(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 1.3) +      # size of in-figure text
    coord_cartesian(xlim = axis_xlim, ylim = axis_ylim) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 95, 99)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 95, 99)) +
    labs(title = title, x = x_lab_text, y = y_lab_text) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7) +                                       # important setting
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey88"),
      panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),                          
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 4.5, face = "bold"),                   # text size in facet header (x)
      strip.text.y = element_text(size = 4.5, face = "bold"),                   # text size in facet header (y)
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray92", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.2),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, b=5),                                       # important to remove excess around (can be slightly added later again)
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
}
```


run functions
```{r}
# run functions
df_bcr <- all_airr %>% filter(receptor == "BCR")
df_tcr <- all_airr %>% filter(receptor == "TCR")

bcr_long <- df_bcr %>% build_bins_n1() %>% make_scatter_long()
tcr_long <- df_tcr %>% build_bins_n1() %>% make_scatter_long()

# 4f
p_bcr <- plot_scatter_grid(bcr_long, x_lab_text = "BCR V identity (%) - right platform", y_lab_text = "BCR V identity (%) - left platform")
# 4g
p_tcr <- plot_scatter_grid(tcr_long, x_lab_text = "TCR V identity (%) - right platform", y_lab_text = "TCR V identity (%) - left platform")
```
